description.value: Ocean Liquor Store is a retail liquor outlet located on Island Highway East in Parksville, on Vancouver Island's popular cycling corridor. The store offers an online ordering system with in-store pickup and carries a range of alcohol products. Cyclists passing through Parksville on the Island Highway route would find it convenient for resupply.

address.value: 491 Island Highway East, Parksville, BC V9P1V9
